{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for invalid revenue values
print(f"Number of invalid revenue entries: {sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum()}")

# Check the distribution of revenue values
print(sales_df['revenue'].describe())"}
